entity.description:
The Fortress of Solitude is the occasional headquarters of DC superhero Superman, and is an arena featured in Mortal Kombat vs. DC Universe. It is made of numerous crystal formations that resemble ice. You can kick a opponent though one of the formations to enter Freefall Kombat before landing on the second floor of the arena.
